arguments.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM transactions t
JOIN cards c ON t.card_id = c.id
WHERE t.amount_usd_cents > 100000
  AND c.card_type = 'Debit'
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions over $1,000 made on debit cards, excluding prepaid debit cards.
assumptions: 'Over 1000 dollars' means amount_usd_cents > 100000, strictly greater than $1,000.
'Debit' means card_type = 'Debit' exactly; 'Debit (Prepaid)' is excluded. The data value is capitalised as 'Debit', so the lowercase 'debit' in the question was read as that value.
The count includes all transactions, labelled or not, since no fraud label filter was requested.
The full date range 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31 is included.
